beats.title: KNIFE SKILLS
beats.subtitle: Cut with confidence and keep your fingers
say: NARRATOR
Welcome to Kitchen Academy. Today, the single skill that makes every recipe faster and safer: how to hold and move a knife.

beats.plain: Everything in its place. Before you cut, set up a stable board, a sharp knife, and a bowl for scraps.
beats.example: Lay a damp towel under the board so it cannot slide while you work.
say: CHEF
Before the blade ever touches food, we set the stage. A damp towel under the board, a sharp knife, a bowl for the scraps.
APPRENTICE
So the setup is part of the skill, not just the cutting?
CHEF
Exactly. A slipping board is how people get hurt.

beats.title: Pinch Grip
beats.plain: Pinch the blade just ahead of the handle between thumb and forefinger for control.
beats.why: The pinch turns your wrist into a precise hinge, so the tip stops wandering.
say: APPRENTICE
Where exactly should my hand be on the knife?
CHEF
Pinch the blade just ahead of the handle, thumb on one side, finger on the other. Now the knife is part of your hand.

beats.quote: Curl the fingertips of your guiding hand under so the flat of the blade rides against your knuckles, never your tips.
beats.cite: Kitchen Academy Handbook  ·  KN-2 The Claw
say: NARRATOR
Curl the fingertips of your guiding hand under so the flat of the blade rides against your knuckles, never your tips.

beats.title: Three checks before you cut
bullets: Board steady on a damp towel
Blade sharp — a dull edge slips
Guiding hand in the claw, tips tucked
beats.note: Set up once, cut safely all session.
say: CHEF
Three checks every time. Steady board, sharp blade, hand in the claw.

beats.q: Where should your guiding fingertips be while slicing?
beats.why: The claw keeps your fingertips behind your knuckles, which guide the blade safely.
say: CHEF
Quick taste test before you go.

beats.title: Knife Skills
bullets: Pinch grip — control from the wrist
Rock, don't saw — tip stays on the board
say: NARRATOR
Master these three, and every recipe gets faster. Next lesson, we put them to work.
